name: Montefalco Sagrantino

known.via: English Wikipedia "Montefalco Sagrantino" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: Montefalco Sagrantino is made as an oak-aged dry red (Secco) and a less common sweet red (Passito). It gained DOCG status.
